# lastping Provider

Manage LastPing monitors, destinations, routing, alert messages, status pages and API keys as code.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) LastPing API key (`lp_…`). May also be set with the `LASTPING_API_KEY` environment variable, which is preferred so the key does not appear in configuration. Create one at https://app.lastping.dev/app/settings.
- `endpoint` (String) LastPing API base URL. Defaults to `https://app.lastping.dev`. May also be set with the `LASTPING_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
